newsitem.title: CHINA: Main body of China troops begin entry into HK.
newsitem.headline: Main body of China troops begin entry into HK.

text.p: The main body of China's 4,000 troops who will serve in Hong Kong began to stream into the region at three crossing points at 6.00 a.m. (2200 GMT Monday) on the first day of Beijing rule, state television said.

The first soldiers of the People's Liberation Army, saluting from armoured personnel carriers and standing erect in hundreds of open trucks, were shown crossing the line that divides China from its new Special Administrative Region.

Stone-faced in the open trucks under driving rain, the soldiers of China's People's Liberation Army saluted to the cheering crowds of tens of thousands lining the streets of the booming border town of Shenzhen and the Man Kam To border crossing.

The troops paraded through Shenzhen's streets, driving past a huge billboard from which the smiling figure of the late paramount leader Deng Xiaoping looks down on the boomtown created by his daring reforms.
A navy patrol boat steamed out earlier from a Shenzhen wharf and was to enter Hong Kong waters at 6.00 a.m., a ship's officer told state television.
Helicopters due to take off from the Nantou airport in Shenzhen were delayed by the heavy rain, state television said.
A total of 4,000 soldiers of army, navy and air force were due to enter Hong Kong early on Tuesday to take over the defence of the region.
